about: Tripo-generated models (ADR 0011). Each model has a brief (prompts, negative prompt, seeds, options), which `npm run tripo -- generate <name>` turns into candidates through the official Tripo CLI (`tripo make`), one per prompt and seed. Use a paid key only: free-tier outputs are public and CC BY. Prompts describe features, never franchise, character, or trademark names (CLAUDE.md).

fighter.role: the sparring opponent, in place of the Training Dummy; its clips take the Dummy director clip names
prompts: Original anime martial-arts hero, adult male, heroic muscular proportions, tall spiky upswept black hair with one teal streak, sleeveless white training gi top over a fitted charcoal bodysuit, crimson waist sash, cloth forearm wraps, fingerless armored gauntlets, knee-high reinforced boots, confident determined expression, full body, standing A-pose with arms slightly away from the body, highly detailed stylized game character

Original comic-book superhero martial artist, adult male, athletic muscular build, short spiky silver-white hair, sleek navy and crimson armored bodysuit with sculpted chest plates and segmented shoulder guards, wide belt with a round star emblem, glowing teal seams on the gauntlets, heavy boots, brow visor plate, full body, standing A-pose with arms slightly away from the body, highly detailed stylized game character
fighter.negative_prompt: text, letters, logo, weapon, claws, cape, extra limbs, extra fingers, blurry, low detail, photorealistic real person

rig.note: The candidate is decimated to `faces` first (scripts/blender/tripo_prepare.py): the retarget failed on the ~780k-face model, and the game needs fewer faces. Rig v1.0 has the 90+ biped presets (box, front kick, hit reactions). Spec "tripo" (native bones): a Mixamo-named rig matches no preset skeleton profile (API error 1004).

fighter.spent_on_diagnosis: rig 015da30b (v2.5, mixamo), rig 4455203f (v1.0, mixamo), rig 7b2804da (v1.0, mixamo, 100k): 75 credits; their retargets failed and were refunded. Multi-preset retarget 6bb52ba3 billed 50 credits for 5 presets but returned only the last (swagger).
